scripts.dev: concurrently --names "pipeline,web,graph" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run pipeline" "npm run web" "npm run graph"
scripts.deploy:push: az acr login --name rezzyacr && docker push rezzyacr.azurecr.io/rezzy-pipeline:latest
scripts.deploy:update: az containerapp update --name rezzy-pipeline --resource-group Rezzy-rg --image rezzyacr.azurecr.io/rezzy-pipeline:latest
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:push && npm run deploy:update
